title: Experts disagree on new evals score script
context:
Chief architect: the four claims are complementary, not opposed; this one fixes the number the gate is on, which the settled design notes require; the fail-on-partial, fail-on-missing-JSON, fail-loudly-on-renamed-field and plain-node-script-under-evals parts are all carried by accepted findings EX-qa-engineer-6 and EX-security-auditor-5 and should be kept in the spec

Target: new evals score script
- devops-engineer: the gate fails the job when the routing or firewall with-arm mean is under 0.9, when any suite JSON is missing, or when partial is true (exit code 2 from a cost ceiling), and it prints each suite's with and without score to the job summary
- integration-architect: the score script reads the --json result by the probed shape (cases[].name, cases[].arms.with[].score, partial, partialReason) and fails loudly with a named error when a field is missing or renamed, instead of scoring zero or passing silently
- integration-architect: the with-plugin suite score is the mean of cases[].arms.with[].score over that suite's cases computed by the script, never aggregates.overallScore; a run with an errored with-arm counts that run as 0, not dropped from the mean
- application-architect: the gate is a small node script under evals/ reading the documented --json shape (cases[].arms.with[].score, partial); it is plain repo tooling, not a paqad-ai CLI verb, and it is covered by the vitest check beside the every-case-has-a-grader test
